stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid espionage allegations, stock plunges and employees push for his return
stories.summary: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned after reports he misled senior executives about his ties to a relative under investigation for potential espionage links to China. Nvidia shares fell to around $163, shedding roughly $573 billion in market value over the past week, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO. Thousands of employees and major shareholders are reportedly pushing for Huang's return, while Nvidia has approached Arm's CEO as a possible replacement; the company's next earnings report, due November 17, is now seen as a major test of investor confidence in the AI trade.

stories.headline: Tech stocks slide as markets brace for a pivotal week for the AI trade
stories.summary: Major technology and AI-linked stocks fell as investors weigh the fallout from the Nvidia leadership crisis alongside upcoming earnings and economic data. The Wall Street Journal reports that next week brings 'big tests' for the AI trade, with sentiment already shaken by Nvidia's turmoil and broader concerns about stretched valuations in AI infrastructure names.

stories.headline: US producer prices rise moderately in October as inflation broadens
stories.summary: The Producer Price Index for October showed moderate month-over-month gains, but Reuters reports the data signals inflation pressures are broadening across more categories of goods and services. The release adds to the Federal Reserve's inflation watch ahead of upcoming policy decisions, with separate commentary from Morningstar noting bond yields are rising again on inflation concerns.

stories.headline: Cisco beats earnings estimates, forecasts AI infrastructure revenue to double this fiscal year
stories.summary: Cisco reported quarterly earnings that topped analyst expectations and said it expects AI infrastructure-related revenue to roughly double in the current fiscal year. The guidance underscores continued enterprise demand for AI networking gear even as other parts of the AI trade face volatility.

stories.headline: Nationwide ground stop cancels thousands of flights, disrupting travel and airline stocks
stories.summary: A Friday nationwide ground stop led to thousands of flight cancellations, with disruptions continuing into Saturday. Separately, an AI company tied to the FAA's SMART tool denied its software was linked to the ground stop, as investigators look into the cause of the outage.

stories.headline: Microsoft and other major software providers restore services after global outage
stories.summary: Microsoft said its services were fully restored after a global outage disrupted governments and businesses, while a separate software provider with thousands of Fortune 500 clients also reported a major outage the same day. The incidents raise questions about cloud infrastructure resilience among large enterprise software vendors.

stories.headline: Wall Street banks pitch for roles in Anthropic's expected IPO
stories.summary: Major Wall Street banks are making their pitches to lead Anthropic's initial public offering, according to the New York Times, as the AI company moves toward a potential listing. The deal would be one of the most closely watched tech IPOs in the current cycle given Anthropic's prominence in the generative AI race.

stories.headline: FBI recovers $1.2 billion in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance
stories.summary: The FBI announced it has recovered approximately $1.2 billion worth of cryptocurrency that was stolen from Binance, marking one of the largest crypto theft recoveries to date. The recovery could bolster confidence in law enforcement's ability to track and reclaim stolen digital assets.
